definitions.started_in_game_injury: Fantasy starter with verified injury-related missed snaps and inability to finish the NFL game normally; temporary full return and finish excluded.
definitions.rotation_injury: Started >=2 of the prior 4 completed fantasy weeks for this manager; injury-limited NFL game ending counts even if benched in fantasy.
definitions.major_rotation_injury: Qualifying rotational injury with >=4 NFL games missed, IR or season-ending absence, corroborated by a severity source.
definitions.non_additive: A single injury may qualify for multiple categories; do not sum category totals.
